name: setup-manaflow-ai-hearth-look
description: A whole cmux look after a warm chat assistant desktop app: a cream paper theme (Hearth) and a warm brown dark (Hearth Dark), serif reading prose at a roomy size and width, prompts as outlined cards on the leading edge with the reply flowing under them as plain prose, a rounded message box and a quiet header. Built only from public surfaces; remove it and everything you had comes back.

files.customize/cmux-app.json:
{
  "$schema": "https://cmux.dev/schemas/cmux-app/2.json",
  "manifestVersion": 2,
  "id": "local/customize",
  "name": { "en": "Hearth sidebar" },
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Hearth's hover card and sidebar rows: the conversation in full, medium names and a soft arc while work runs.",
  "engines": { "cmux": "^2.0" },
  "repository": "https://github.com/local/customize",
  "runtime": { "main": "main.js" },
  "implements": {
    "cmux.hovercard/1": { "export": "renderCard" },
    "cmux.sidebar.rows/1": { "export": "decorateRows" }
  },
  "scopes": { "workspace:read": "Name the rows to decorate." },
  "activation": ["onInterface:cmux.hovercard/1", "onInterface:cmux.sidebar.rows/1"],
  "files": ["main.js"]
}
files.themes/hearth-dark.json:
// Hearth Dark: the same desk by lamplight. A warm brown-black page (#1f1c19), the sidebar a step
// darker (#191714), warm off-white ink (#ece6dc) and the terracotta lifted (#e08a63) to read on it.
{
  "name": "Hearth Dark",
  "description": "A warm brown-black page, warm off-white ink, a darker sidebar and a lifted terracotta accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Dark",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#1f1c19", "foreground": "#ece6dc", "selection": "#3a332c", "accent": "#e08a63" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 272,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#191714",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#1f1c19",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#1f1c19",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc"
}
files.themes/hearth.json:
// Hearth: warm cream paper. The page a soft cream (#f7f3ea), the sidebar a shade deeper (#efe9dc),
// warm near-black ink (#2b2722) and a terracotta accent (#b0532f) for focus and links.
{
  "name": "Hearth",
  "description": "Warm cream paper, warm ink, a deeper cream sidebar and a terracotta accent.",

  "appearance.theme": "Builtin Light",
  // The window, sidebar and pages take that theme too, over an App Theme of your own.
  "appearance.appTheme": "followTerminal",
  "colors": { "background": "#f7f3ea", "foreground": "#2b2722", "selection": "#e6dccb", "accent": "#b0532f" },
  "appearance.accent": "theme",

  "appearance.background": "none",
  "appearance.borders": "none",
  "appearance.chromeStyle": "flat",
  "appearance.titleAreaTone": "oneColor",
  "appearance.density": "comfortable",

  // Proportions: a roomy 272 pt sidebar of 32 pt rows, 13 pt chrome text.
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarWidth": 272,
  "appearance.metrics.sidebarRowHeight": 32,
  "appearance.metrics.chromeFontSize": 13,

  "appearance.sidebarSurface": "separate",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.color": "#efe9dc",
  "appearance.surfaces.sidebar.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.color": "#f7f3ea",
  "appearance.surfaces.agentPane.opacity": 1,
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.color": "#f7f3ea",
  "appearance.surfaces.tabBar.opacity": 1,
  "sidebar.sectionLook": "quiet",
  "appearance.statusIndicator.style": "arc"
}
